Title: Custom Commands is now generally available

Body.Content:
Streamline the process for creating task-oriented voice applications with Custom Commands, now generally available. Custom Commands, a capability of Speech in Azure Cognitive Services, provides a unified authoring experience, an automatic hosting model, and is best suited for task completion or command-and-control scenarios that have a well-defined sets of variables such as IoT scenarios like controlling a thermostat.

To learn more, read the blog.

Read the documentation

Try the demos
